title: Endpoint orthonormal Strichartz estimates
summary: We establish the orthonormal Strichartz estimates in the abstract Keel--Tao framework, under precisely the same hypotheses as in their original theorem. As an important consequence, we resolve the endpoint conjecture for the Schrödinger equation in dimensions $d\ge 2$, which was first raised by Frank, Lewin, Lieb, and Seiringer. This consequence also yields an affirmative answer to the conjecture for the free transport equation, which was stated in dual form by Bennett, Bez, Gutiérrez, and Lee.
